notes: Page title 'Cheesy Entrée', tagline 'We at Gluttons Garage would love to kickstart your engines with our wide variety of starters'. Deep reddish-brown/maroon background with gear pattern; title and 'Toppings' heading in lime/yellow-green decorative serif, item names bold yellow serif (smaller bold qualifiers like '(4 nos)'), descriptions small white sans, prices right-aligned yellow with '/-'. Green/red dot markers. 'Junktion77 - The Foodies' Crossroads' logo top right. Bottom photo: glossy BBQ-glazed chicken/meat pieces with spring onion. No tax note. Fully legible. Crispy Fried Veggies / Baby Corn / Paneer item lists 3 prices in printed order (mapping to sub-items assumed by order); Hot wings single price 210/- for all flavours. Spellings as printed: 'Bytes', 'Croqouttes', 'brocccoli', 'nugettes', 'chilly', 'satisifies', 'Napolean'.
